Name: DE-JobsCount
Description: Gets the count of jobs for the given filters.
Statement:
select  count(*) as [Count]
from    JobLookup job
            left join Deliverable del on del.Oid = job.Id
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = job.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
where   wst.Status not in (1) and
        (@ModifiedFrom is null or del.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom) and
        (@JobId is null or job.Id = @JobId) and
        (@JobNumber is null or job.Number = @JobNumber)
